database.nativeWire: The production Swift client used an ephemeral HTTPS certificate, a fixture identity provider and the actual service. Free and paid scenarios covered replay, selection, narrow access, period planning and restored enrollment.

releaseBuild: Unsigned arm64 Release for device SDK passed compiled metadata checks. Debug installed and launched on the iPhone 17 simulator.
airPrint: System print formatter generated multipage PDF. No physical print was performed.

dinnersToDecisionHistory.scope: iPhone 17e iOS 27, 319 app tests and one Free UI journey on a frozen source tree. The UI started a dinner, protected lunch portions, reconciled actual fill, prepared a dated cook instruction, recorded optional zero incremental benefit, created a fresh next shop and reopened the local repair in Records. Local simulator data only. The later standalone pantry entry and ingredient-stock route are outside this snapshot.
dinnersToDecisionHistory.earlierAttempt: .build/StaplesDecisionsFullJourney.xcresult passed 316 app tests but crashed opening the cook form in the UI test during concurrent source/build changes. The clean build completed the same journey. No deterministic cause was established.

decisionWire.scope: Actual local PostgreSQL, HTTP service, Swift client over local HTTPS, and compiled browser client running in JSDOM. Real Apple purchases and a deployed provider were outside this run.

integratedStagedCode.scope: Frozen repository source including configured staging metadata. PostgreSQL integration used isolated local identities and actual Swift and browser clients. Only public boundary checks used the hosted staging environment.

requestPackWire.environment: Isolated local PostgreSQL database and compiled service, native HTTPS client and browser client
